definition: the odds an organisation is degrading now or will inside a horizon I care about

settled:
Already degrading is the top band. The decay is visible and they are failing my test today.

High means the pressure signals are there. A recent change of owner, activist investors, an industry consolidating. Their behaviour is trending the wrong way.

Medium means no specific signal, and no trust earned either.

Low means they pass my test outright. Decades of record plus refusing to yield when pushed. Costco is the mark.

An organisation I have not assessed starts at medium or worse. Every organisation is under pressure at once right now, so quiet is not evidence.

Trust earned by nothing having gone wrong yet is not earned.

title: How Likely They Are To Get Worse
